highlights: UGREEN 90399 USB-C Charger 45W Nexode GaN Dual Ports Plug Support PD 3.0/PPS

Advanced GaN II Technology: Thanks to the latest GaN II Technology, the foldable 45W USB C charger is much smaller in size with a 20% increase in operating frequency, an innovative stacked design, and an upgraded circuit board structure

Dual Ports, Double Fast: the 45W GaN USB C charger adopts a power dispenser system for intelligent power distribution and supports fast charging to 2 ports; 45 Watt Power Delivery and 25W PPS Output with a single USB C port loaded to provide more power for your iPhone 17 Pro Max and adaptive power for your more device, allowing you to charge 2 devices simultaneously (Note: Supports Super Fast Charging but does not support 45W super fast charging 2.0)

Multiple Fast Charge Protocols: Together with multiple fast charging protocols for the new generation of smartphones and improved PPS adaptive charging, the GaN USB C Charger supports PD 3.0/2.0 QC 4.0/3.0/2.0 PPS(25W) and BC 1.2 fast charge protocols, and charges most devices at a quite fast speed; Upgraded with a 45W max output so you can charge your phone, tablet, earbuds, and even your laptop with such a tiny charger

Charging Protection with Thermal Guard: Nexode 45W USB C power supply always delivers the same fantastic performance, no matter when charging at full speed or trickle charging, the GaN charger delivers adaptive performance; Thermal Guard technology measures the temperature 800 times per second in real time, ensuring safe and fast charging of your device

Universal Compatibility: This PD 45W USB C fast Charger is compatible with MacBook Air 2022 M2, XPS 13 laptop, iPad Air, iPhone 17/16/15/14/13 Series, Galaxy S25, Pixel 9, Mi 13, Huawei P40, Steam Deck, Switch, etc
